title: Hypothesis Confidence Engine
goal: Calculate confidence, missing evidence, and next safe validation step for each evidence hypothesis.
scope: Bounded defensive hypothesis scoring for evidence review.
generation_reason: Operators need transparent confidence and evidence gaps before AI-guided assessment paths can be trusted.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement bounded defensive hypothesis scoring for evidence review. No exploit generation, no active runtime actions, no credential use.

success_criteria: Hypotheses include confidence score, missing evidence, supporting evidence, and contradicting evidence.
Tests cover IDOR, OAuth scope, SSRF-to-cloud, weak auth, and SaaS connector exposure.

acceptance_criteria: Hypothesis payloads show confidence, missing evidence, supporting evidence, and contradicting evidence.
IDOR, OAuth scope, SSRF-to-cloud, weak auth, and SaaS connector exposure fixtures are covered.
Recommendations are review-only and create no tasks, approvals, or runtime actions.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next task into NEXT_TASK.md.
